notes.title: Some news about Diluvian Winds
notes.notes:
Hi fellow travelers!

A few months ago Diluvian Winds was released in 1.0. We want to thank you all for your time on our game.
Since then, we've been working on the game’s console version.

As we're nearing the end of development, part of the team has been gathering feedback from players.
Several topics came up regularly, including difficulty and challenge.
When we developed Diluvian Winds, we intended for the game to be a gateway to management games for inexperienced players, but we also wanted different mechanics to allow regular players to get the most out of the game in terms of optimization.

Given the various feedback received, it seems clear that the game's difficulty does not allow the vast number of players to find what they're looking for once the story mode is over. As a result, the scoring mode, designed as an optimization challenge, has not been played a lot.
In response to this feedback, we are currently testing various balancing changes. We're encouraged by the results and hope to be able to offer you a playable version soon.
So over the coming months, we will return to a rhythm of game updates; balancing and improving gameplay quality.

Thank you for your feedback, and we look forward to sharing the changes with you soon.

notes.title: Manor Lords too realistic or grimy for you? Try cosy survival townbuilder Diluvian Winds, out today
notes.notes:
Manor Lords is obviously this week's big survival-citybuilder game release, but I suspect Diluvian Winds is more my pace. It's a "relaxing management game" about building a town for anthropomorphic animals around the foot of a lighthouse, although exactly how relaxing will depend on your ability to prepare for tsunamis and other weather emergencies which can strike and destroy your buildings. It's out now.

Read more

notes.title: Diluvian Winds 1.0 is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

This is it: Diluvian Winds 1.0 version is officially out now!

Besides expanding your hamlet on land and under the sea, the aerial route is now available!
Welcome 5 new species to your hamlet, run expeditions, find artifacts, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/1a480757750d3431821e6789acd8ccc0bfc5071f.png[/img]

[h3]Aerial Way[/h3]

With this update comes the third survival way centered around a new game mechanic : the Expeditions. 
Expeditions are a way to gather resources and gain project points. To do so, players choose travelers to send to far lands aboard an aircraft. Travelers stop at a different location each day, storing whatever they find in the aircraft's hold. 
5 new traveler's species are coming. Also, every species can now give bonuses when being sent on expeditions.

[h3]Textile[/h3]

Textile is a new resource that is needed to send expeditions. 
They are mainly produced in a workshop on the Aerial Dock. 

[h3]Chapters[/h3]

Story Mode's chapters 7 and 8 are now available. They allow players to familiarize themselves with the aerial way and artifacts. Other chapters have also been improved

[h3]Artifacts[/h3]

Rare resources found mainly during Expeditions, the Artifacts allow the player to do special actions by consuming them. For example: building a room instantly, changing the fire color to attract specific species. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/2345229a254f1b8c24562901b93dee7896a81654.png[/img]

[h3]Fire[/h3]

Players can revive the fire by spending the usual resources. Be careful, the cost of doing so will increase each time you revive it in higher difficulties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/fd01b2e492cf3c760a3e2350d0c5029989cf9ddc.png[/img]

[h3]Achievements[/h3]

Achievements are now available. Challenge yourself and try to complete them all to become a Lighthouse Keeper.

[h3]Community feedback[/h3]

We implemented various feedback such as being able to destroy lodgements and having a way to increase the construction grids. Thank you to all the Early Access players for helping us.

[h3]And more![/h3]

Visual and sound enhancements, quality-of-life improvements, a reworked scoring mode, new projects...

[h3]Play now:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561040/Diluvian_Winds/

A message from the developers at Alambik Studio:

[quote=author]Diluvian Winds 1.0.0 is now available! It's been a long journey, and we're delighted to share our first game with you! Thanks to all the demo and early access players for their feedback; you've helped us make the game better. Did you like the game and want to help? The best way is to leave a Steam review! 
Enjoy the game!

What's next? 
Diluvian Winds is going to be ported to consoles, so we'll be working on controller support. We'll be continuing to improve the game with minor updates to user experience and quality of play. Don't hesitate to give us your feedback![/quote]

[previewyoutube=poCobhtX37o;full][/previewyoutube]

-Alambik Studio & Goblinz Publishing

notes.title: Devlog: Aerial Way - Concept art
notes.notes:
With the full release of Diluvian Winds just around the corner, the developers at Alambik Studio wanted to highlight how they worked to add the aerial way to the game, the major new feature of the 1.0 release.

Without further ado, let's dive into it!

[hr][/hr]

Hello everyone,

With the 1.0 update, the aerial way will be one of the most significant additions. In this Devlog, we will share with you the process of how the art team operates, using the addition of new aerial assets as an example.

It starts with a meeting with the Game Design team. We aim to have a more or less precise idea of what the new additions will be, roughly define what is expected of us, as well as define the possibilities and constraints that we will need to keep in mind during the Sketches stage.

This is followed by a discussion among the artists regarding their vision for the aerial aspect. They do not necessarily have to be similar; on the contrary, some of the most interesting ideas come from merging different visions.

[h3]Moodboard and References[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/5c8384a5437900f7f3e89da410cf994dc62d510e.png[/img]

[h3]Sketch Phase[/h3]

Concepts are unleashed without too much thought to constraints; several paths can be explored, and ideas can be mixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/0875bafb5e326791ef4dccecfb5348a9bb7f288f.png[/img]

[h3]Integration of test assets[/h3]

Once we have defined the concepts that are most pleasing, we integrate the first placeholder assets into the Unity game engine for testing. This phase is important because it allows us to:

[list][*] Verify if the assets/concepts are coherent
[*] Adjust these according to gameplay or other constraints (pathfinding, visibility, screen space, composition)
[*] Preview assets in the engine
[*] See how to separate future elements that compose the aerial landscape[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/9d6edc782b0593e1d819edb7a572cbe57986061e.png[/img]

[h3]More defined concepts of all elements[/h3]

Once this step is completed, we begin to create concepts on more specific points (construction stage, rooms composing the aerial way, reflections on animatable elements...)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/82490155a70a2bada498c55519ca2c0211d84719.png[/img]

[h3]Clean and integration of final assets[/h3]

Once the concepts are validated, we clean them up one by one. They are then placed in atlases and integrated into the engine. This is one of the longest steps for the artists.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/8b344bfdb6d4a92f6d87e9ca4fb07937bf633f41.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/7cd414feb22dad84ba6e7255bcadf004be857823.png[/img]

We use the Navigation Room (one of the new additions in 1.0 version) as an example here.
We won't show you everything to keep some surprises. ;)

See you in two days to try out all the new content we've prepared for you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561040/Diluvian_Winds/

notes.title: 🦝 The Merchant Update is here!

Diluvian Winds’ second major update is here!

In this update, we've introduced a brand-new addition to the game: the Merchants. These adorable yet fearless adventurers sail the seas to engage in trade. Despite their friendly appearance, don't underestimate their business acumen – they are shrewd entrepreneurs!

The Merchants are brave travelers who traverse the world in their boats.

notes.title: Simfest and first update! 🌈
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have some exciting news to share! [b]Diluvian Winds is now part of Simfest[/b], a great Steam festival celebrating all things related to simulation games.

During Simfest, you'll have the opportunity to explore the latest and most thrilling simulation titles. And here's the best part: [b]From today until July 24th, 2023 at 10 am PDT, you can enjoy a fantastic 20% discount on Diluvian Winds![/b]

That's not all! We're also thrilled to announce[b] the game's first update[/b]. We've added new settings and difficulties to the game modes [b](Story, Sandbox, and Scoring)[/b]. Plus, we've introduced a [b]photo [/b]mode so you can easily share beautiful screenshots with your friends!

[b]Make sure to check out the full patchnote for all the details:
[/b]
[expand type=patchnote]
Summary

-New sandbox settings
-New scoring and story difficulties (easy and hard)
-A new photo mode
-Quality of life improvements
-Bug fixes and balancing

/!\ KNOWN BUGS /!\

-Loading an old save in story mode (saved before update 0.6.0) may result in a soft lock (the query you need to perform in order to progress is not present)
-Localization is not complete for some languages

GAME MODES 

We've added a seed system for the scoring and sandbox game modes. It allows you to have the same start using the same seed and the same parameters when launching a game.

Story
Two new difficulty modes: Easy and Hard.

Sandbox
-New parameters for customizing a game
-Disaster on/off
-Disaster phase frequency
-Intervals between disasters
-Rainbow weather duration
-Quantity of plans obtained
-Starting prototype points
-Fire weather penalty
-Morale weather penalty
-Quantity of starting resources
-Overheating gauge size
-Number of restarts in the caravan

Scoring (BETA)
-Two new difficulty modes: Easy and Hard

PHOTO MODE

We've also added a photo mode. Take your best in-game photos and share them with your friend!
It includes the following settings: 
-Staging
-Zoom level
-Show / Hide room interiors
-Lighthouse light orientation
-Display settings
-Brightness
-Contrast
-Saturation
-Filters
-Frames & Decorations
-Thumbnail Size / Intensity
-Frames
-Fancy & Decorations
-Logo
-Caption


CHANGES AND BUG FIXES

Story mode
-The "Build a Mine" objective validates correctly if a mine exists before unlocking it.
-Waves appear correctly when continuing a game after completing Chapter 4

Sandbox Mode
-Sandbox Mode is now permanently unlocked

Scoring Mode
-Scoring Mode is now permanently unlocked

notes.title: Devlog: A new weather forecast
notes.notes:
Greetings travelers We are the Alambik Studio team. We are happy to meet you again for this second devlog about Diluvian Winds!

[h3][b]- A new forecast[/b][/h3]

Today, we will describe a core element of the game: weather and natural disasters. Throughout your experience, weather influences everything in the game and hinders progress. Even if the weather looks like an obstacle, being adaptive lets you carry through your plans and get the most out of any situations.

And here's the trick: each weather effect offers a unique challenge: foggy weather affects the morale of your travelers while a bright shiny sun affects resources production. It is also the perfect opportunity for us to offer immersive visual and sound design related to the different day's phases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/a2c931c7e8877fa88765b4879dda8e95a2fd8b13.png[/img]

[h3][b]- Brace yourselves[/b][/h3]

Weather is a core mechanic, and natural disasters are the equal of bosses. During the Prologue, you encountered a giant wave that is testing your base. Get ready for the next disasters as they will join the party during the development of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/54d5ad29277a22b4500c4de42c2e30cb4d9a5b71.png[/img]

[h3]-[b] You sent your feedback, we listened![/b][/h3]

We dived into reworking how weather disasters would appear. In the previous version, they would appear after a challenging weather creating unfair difficulty spikes, which could be overwhelming at the time.

With the new system, we have now splitted weather effects from natural disasters to allow more flexibility and control over randomness. Also, it opens a good development angle towards the behavior of weather as you progress through a run, which provides a more appropriate challenge throughout the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/05db0787027068fe708f444e7818a2a8882f9ba4.gif[/img]

Thank you for the warm comments and feedback you submitted after playing the Prologue. 
Know that we are currently working on the Early Access which is planned for early next year!
We are so happy to share our work and look forward to your feedback! If you want to follow our game’s development and support us, you can always follow us on social media.

[b]What you can do to support us:[/b]
- Wishlist the game on Steam!
- Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/alambikstudio

Play the Prologue:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1843430/Diluvian_Winds_Prologue/

[b]Alambik Studio[/b] team

notes.title: Prologue out soon & Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are so glad to announce we have a release date for [b]Diluvian Winds Prologue[/b]! 🎉

The free version of our upcoming building and management game [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561040/Diluvian_Winds/]Diluvian Winds[/url][/b] will launch on [b]September 21st[/b]. 

[h3]🔽 Wishlist to be notified on release day![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1843430/Diluvian_Winds_Prologue/

To celebrate this announcement, we have decided to make a first devlog so you can learn more about the game. Enjoy your reading below!

[hr][/hr]
Welcome to our very first devlog, where we are going to talk about the travelers who live in the world of Diluvian Winds. In our game, you will welcome different wanderers in a hamlet tied to a lighthouse that will help you manage your base.

It was very important for us to offer diverse and endearing characters through several species with a different version of clothing and colors for each one of them - which is also very useful for character identification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/a8c0cbcb2321ed061565f92e7cd333b43592e3a5.png[/img]

To mark the idea around the characters traveling the world of Diluvian Winds, we decided that the characters would be able to frequently come and leave the hamlet. It allows the player to change from an inhabitant to another and adapt depending on the needs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/42841ece86b33fb6adc531869e9f9db5716e3dc2.gif[/img]

In exchange for shelter in the hamlet, the Travelers help the Lighthouse Keeper! Characters have different personal traits which allow them to do different actions for resource production. For example, Beavers are experts in woodworking and have diverse bonuses tied to wood production!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40103569/135b74cc1799618039ae8b5b16b3d4151b5c201f.gif[/img]

What’s next?

Diluvian Winds was playable during Gamescom 2022, at Goblinz Publishing booth, and we wanted to thank you for the warm feedback you gave us. But don’t worry, the prologue is coming on September 21th so you can all enjoy Diluvian Winds for real! 

We are so happy to share our work and we are looking forward to your feedback! If you want to follow our game’s development and support us, you can always follow us on social media.

Thank you for reading and have fun!

-Alambik Studio team
